messages:
michael: :rotating_light: Root: Were seeing stale cache responses from edge-cache for Private deployments in ap-southeast-1. First reports at ~04:00 UTC. Some customers see outdated model responses after config changes. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2139000000

oncall-bot: Alert: edge-cache-invalidate-fail > 0.5% across ap-southeast-1 cluster. Paging @tara and @ops.

tara: Triage summary: cache invalidation requests were enqueued but a recent change to the invalidation worker introduced a race when processing batched invalidations. The worker acknowledged at queue level but failed to apply deletions to a subset of cache shards when backlog > 1000, leaving stale entries.

ops: Mitigations applied at 04:07 UTC: 1) reverted the batched invalidation change, 2) forced synchronous invalidation for ap-southeast-1 while we drain the backlog, 3) scaled invalidation workers x2 to catch up.

michael: Impact: customers using immediate invalidation (private hosting + config pinning) may receive cached outputs for up to ~15 minutes until backlog drains. No request failures, purely freshness degradation. Affected customers flagged in internal list.

lloyd: Metrics: invalidation-apply-lag dropped from median 420s -> 18s within 9 minutes. Backlog reduced to near zero after worker scale. Canary checks for cache freshness look good.

cs: Customer comms draft: "Were investigating delayed cache invalidation for Private deployments in AP-SOUTHEAST-1 affecting freshness of responses after config/model changes. We have applied mitigations and are monitoring; freshness should return shortly. We will provide a post-incident summary." Ready to send after 30m stability.

ops: Temporary ops commands (internal):

```
# force synchronous invalidation for region
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.ai/cache/invalidate -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" -d '{"region":"ap-southeast-1","mode":"sync","scope":"all"}'
# scale invalidation workers
kubectl scale deployment/invalidate-worker --replicas=10 -n infra
```

deploy-bot: Severity set to S3 at 04:18 UTC after mitigations. Monitoring active.

tara: Next actions: 1) revert is in prod (complete), 2) add backlog-aware batching with safety throttle, 3) add alerting for enqueue-ack vs apply-confirm mismatch, 4) author playbook entry for invalidation races. Postmortem owners: @tara (root cause + fix) and @lloyd (metrics + monitoring). ETA for draft: EOD today.

michael: Thank you team  please continue to monitor ap-southeast-1 and ping this thread for regressions. End of broadcast. :white_check_mark:
